title: THE BELT AND THE BACKPACK DRAW THE NEW ICONS
why: The art pass of 2026-10-03 reached the menus but not the raid: the belt and backpack painted every icon live on the HUD each frame, flat and without the lift. They now draw a sprite painted once per item and size at the screen scale, with the same lift: sharper, shaded like the stash, and one draw call per icon instead of thirty fills.
now: The tactical belt and the raid backpack show the same shaded, sharp icons as the stash.
